slides.title: Evaluate a single-pod Omnigent deployment on OpenShift.

narration.text: The objective was to containerize Omnigent on UBI 9 and deploy it as a single non-root pod on OpenShift.
This narration describes the archived October twentieth run.
It does not repeat the tests or turn later observations into original validation.

slides.title: Five HTTP checks covered the pre-authentication surface.

narration.text: The validation used five HTTP smoke checks: health, version information, server information, the web user interface, and the login page.
These checks covered reachability and the pre-authentication surface.
Loading a login page does not demonstrate a successful authenticated workflow.

slides.title: UBI 9 hosted the server with SQLite on emptyDir storage.

narration.text: The deployed server ran in a UBI 9 image, behind a Service and an HTTPS Route.
SQLite used emptyDir storage.
That makes the recorded setup useful for a proof of concept, while data durability still needs a separate decision before production use.

slides.title: Trimming the build Dockerfile resolved an unavailable package.

narration.text: The first image build failed because an unused Dockerfile stage requested a package unavailable in UBI 9.
A trimmed build Dockerfile allowed the next build to complete and publish to Quay.
This correction matters because it explains how the deployment became possible.

slides.title: All five original validation checks passed.

narration.text: All five original HTTP validation scenarios passed.
These results describe individual smoke checks, not a performance benchmark or a production reliability guarantee.
The successful smoke checks do not establish authenticated agent execution or complete application behavior.
Authentication, external integrations, and production reliability require additional validation.
OpenShift deployment success should therefore be read within this limited test scope.

slides.title: Traces, original UI recordings and the worker workspace were not retained.

narration.text: No distributed trace export, run-specific browser trace archive, or original user interface recording was retained in the archived evidence.
The presentation cannot reconstruct those missing observations.
The original worker workspace was also not archived; this presentation uses the committed evidence copies.

slides.title: Validate authenticated workflows and durable storage before production.

narration.text: The next decision should focus on authenticated end-to-end workflows and durable storage.
Keep the successful deployment and five passing smoke checks as the established baseline.
Broader production adoption requires evidence that goes beyond that baseline.
